info.description: Code generated by scripts/gensdk from api/redx-api.json. DO NOT EDIT. Every operation carries x-redx-danger (safe < write < admin < dangerous) and x-redx-auth. SDKs refuse dangerous operations unless the call is confirmed.
info.title: RedX HTTP API

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: changes data inside the key's own scope
x-redx-danger-levels.name: write

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: changes host or database definitions; reversible
x-redx-danger-levels.name: admin

x-redx-danger-levels.meaning: irreversible, grants or removes access, or moves leadership; SDKs refuse it unless the call is explicitly confirmed
x-redx-danger-levels.name: dangerous

x-rottenapple-levels.notes: safe and write calls on the app's own workspace are the data.redx service (L1 in Rotten Apple's SDK levels). admin and dangerous calls are developer and operator tools only: they must not be exposed to in-app code through the launcher.
